description.value: Best Buy #6 Cowichan Bay is part of a locally owned, Vancouver Island-based liquor store group operating since 1986. The Cowichan Bay location recently expanded into a 3,500 sq ft 'Superstore' format, making it one of the larger stops on the Trans-Canada corridor through the Cowichan Valley. It is positioned directly off the highway with ample parking, offering a broad selection of beer, wine, spirits, and coolers.
